name: Marco
effect:
If one of your Characters would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may K.O. this Character instead.
[On K.O.] You may trash 1 card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: Play this Character card from your trash.

official_faq.question: If this Character and another one of my Characters, Character A, would be K.O.'d at the same time by an opponent's effect, can I use this Character's effect to K.O. this Character instead?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. In this case, only this Character is K.O.'d, and Character A remains on the field.

official_faq.question: If this Character would be returned to my hand or placed at the bottom of my deck by an opponent's effect, can I K.O. this Character instead?
